text: At 65 minutes, Redmond Rovers make a tactical shift to press more intensely and push their defensive line higher up the field near the halfway line. They begin playing more direct passes aimed at quickly reaching Ironvale Athletic’s goal at the far end. This change reduces their possession around the midfield but increases their attacking threat close to Ironvale’s penalty area. Ironvale adapts by dropping deeper, limiting their chances as Redmond applies constant pressure further up the pitch [#1190].
